definitions.explanation: Indicates that something is done or changed to the fullest extent.

examples.japanese: すっかり⟦{忘|わす}れていた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すっかり⟦{治|なお}った→治る：00735_naoru⟧。
⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すっかり⟦{暗|くら}くなった→暗い：00647_kurai⟧。
examples.english: It has gotten completely dark outside.

examples.japanese: すっかり⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦になりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すっかり⟦{掃除|そうじ}した→掃除する：02889_souji⟧。

notes:
すっかり emphasizes that something has completely or thoroughly changed or been done.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- すっかり⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧: to completely forget
- すっかり⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: to completely change
- すっかり⟦{治|なお}る→治る：00735_naoru⟧: to fully recover
- すっかり⟦{暗|くら}くなる→暗い：00647_kurai⟧: to become completely dark

SIMILAR WORDS:
- すっかり: completely (emphasis on thoroughness of change/completion)
- ⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧: all, everything (emphasis on quantity)
- ⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧: not at all (used with negatives); completely (casual, with positives)
- ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧に: completely, perfectly (formal)

USAGE:
すっかり often describes changes in state or condition. It implies that the change is complete, leaving nothing of the original state.
